verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management platform. Reviewing AI agent code diffs with line-level comments from a mobile app is a code-hosting or coding-agent capability, so this story is outside Asana's product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana ships code review. The GitHub integration only syncs pull request status to tasks, and AI Teammates handle coordination work, not code changes.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
